name: The Grave Shift
source:
There's souls that need judgement - that's your job. Which souls go to Heaven, and which go to Hell?

As a demon yourself, you do have a vested interest in sending some people to Hell - your boss has given you a quota - not that he ever tells you what that is. But don't you feel a little bad for some of these people? 

You get to decide. But if you don't meet the quota, you'll regret it.

[From [url=https://zephyreds.itch.io/the-grave-shift]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有些灵魂需要判断——那是你的工作。哪些灵魂去天堂，哪些灵魂去地狱？

作为一个恶魔，你确实有将一些人送入地狱的既得利益——你的老板给了你一个配额——但他从来没有告诉过你那是什么。但你不为其中一些人感到有点难过吗？

你必须做出决定。但如果你没有达到配额，你就会后悔的。

[来自[url=https://zephyreds.itch.io/the-grave-shift]Itch.io[/url]]
